subtitle: Lesson 22 · Oracle Backup & Recovery

eyebrow: Directory object, then a schema export
caption: Every Data Pump job references a server-side directory object by name.

eyebrow: Import can reshape what it loads
code:
impdp hr/password DIRECTORY=dpump_dir \
  DUMPFILE=hr_schema.dmp \
  REMAP_SCHEMA=hr:hr_staging \
  REMAP_TABLESPACE=hr_data:hr_staging_data

-- Selective export:
TABLES=hr.orders
QUERY="hr.orders:\"WHERE order_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)-30\""
caption: REMAP_SCHEMA, TABLES, and QUERY have no RMAN equivalent at all.
